SELECT
    w.w_state,
    i.i_item_id,
    COALESCE(SUM(cs.cs_sales_price - COALESCE(cr.cr_refunded_cash, 0)) FILTER (WHERE CAST(d.d_date AS date) < CAST('2001-05-02' AS date)), 0) AS sales_before,
    COALESCE(SUM(cs.cs_sales_price - COALESCE(cr.cr_refunded_cash, 0)) FILTER (WHERE CAST(d.d_date AS date) >= CAST('2001-05-02' AS date)), 0) AS sales_after
FROM (
    SELECT i_item_sk, i_item_id
    FROM item
    WHERE i_current_price BETWEEN 0.99 AND 1.49
) i
JOIN catalog_sales cs ON i.i_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
JOIN (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_date
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_date BETWEEN CAST('2001-04-02' AS date) AND CAST('2001-06-01' AS date)
) d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
JOIN warehouse w ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cs.cs_order_number = cr.cr_order_number AND cs.cs_item_sk = cr.cr_item_sk
GROUP BY w.w_state, i.i_item_id
ORDER BY w.w_state, i.i_item_id
LIMIT 100
